title: AI
content:
# AI

AIUI is designed for AI application development. Its most common capabilities can be grouped into three areas: understanding what the user says, speaking the result back, and directly invoking a large language model for understanding, reasoning, and generation.

If you are building a complete voice agent, you will typically combine these three capabilities:

- **Speech Recognition**: Converts what the user says into text.
- **Large Language Model**: Understands the context and generates a reply.
- **Speech Synthesis**: Reads the generated result back to the user.

## Work with the Current Agent Session

Use [Agent Sessions](/AIUI/api/ai-agent-session) to publish background context, send user messages and cards, call remote tools, and read resources.

These session capabilities are separate from directly creating a `LanguageModelSession`. Application state and cards do not automatically become model input.

## How To Choose

- Want your app to understand user input: use `Speech Recognition`
- Want your app to speak text aloud: use `Speech Synthesis`
- Want your app to perform Q&A, summarization, generation, or reasoning: use `Large Language Model`

## Simple Example

For example, first check whether the model capability is available, then send a prompt:

```javascript
const status = await LanguageModel.availability();

if (status === 'available') {
  const session = await LanguageModel.create();

  const result = await session.prompt('请用一句话介绍 AIUI');
  console.log(result);
}
```

## Continue Reading

- **[Speech Recognition](/AIUI/api/ai-speech-recognition)**: See how to capture the user's voice and receive recognition results.
- **[Speech Synthesis](/AIUI/api/ai-speech-synthesis)**: See how to synthesize text into spoken output.
- **[Large Language Model](/AIUI/api/ai-language-model)**: See how to create model sessions, request replies, and read streamed output.
- **[WeChat Mini Program Compatible APIs](/AIUI/api/weixin-compatible-apis)**: See compatible speech APIs.

title: AI
content:
# AI

AIUI 面向 AI 应用开发，常见能力可以分成三类：听懂用户说的话、把结果播报出来，以及直接调用大语言模型完成理解、推理和生成。

如果你要构建一个完整的语音智能体，通常会把这三类能力组合起来使用：

- **语音识别**：把用户说的话转成文本。
- **大语言模型**：理解上下文并生成回复。
- **语音播报**：把生成结果再读给用户听。

## 与当前 Agent 会话协作

通过 [Agent 会话](/AIUI/api/ai-agent-session) 发布背景上下文、发送用户消息和卡片，以及调用远端工具和读取资源。

这些会话能力与直接创建 `LanguageModelSession` 分开；应用状态和卡片不会自动成为模型输入。

## 如何选择

- 想让应用“听懂”用户输入：使用 `语音识别`
- 想让应用把文本“说出来”：使用 `语音播报`
- 想让应用完成问答、总结、生成、推理：使用 `大语言模型`

## 简单示例

例如，先判断模型能力是否可用，再发起一次提问：

```javascript
const status = await LanguageModel.availability();

if (status === 'available') {
  const session = await LanguageModel.create();

  const result = await session.prompt('请用一句话介绍 AIUI');
  console.log(result);
}
```

## 继续阅读

- **[语音识别](/AIUI/api/ai-speech-recognition)**：查看如何采集用户语音并接收识别结果。
- **[语音播报](/AIUI/api/ai-speech-synthesis)**：查看如何把文本合成为播报语音。
- **[大语言模型](/AIUI/api/ai-language-model)**：查看如何创建模型会话、请求回复和读取流式输出。
- **[微信小程序兼容 API](/AIUI/api/weixin-compatible-apis)**：查看微信小程序兼容语音接口。

title: Agent Sessions
content:
# Agent Sessions

Use `getApp().getAgent()` to publish background data, send user messages, send cards, call remote tools, and read resources in the current Agent session. It does not create a model or a new conversation.

## Check What the Session Supports

In an App or Page, use `getApp().getAgent()` to get the current session, then read `agent.capabilities`. This example logs the actual values and checks whether the session can send text, call remote tools, and receive list change notifications.

```javascript
const agent = getApp().getAgent();
const capabilities = agent.capabilities;
console.log(JSON.stringify({ connectionState: agent.connectionState, capabilities }));

const canSendText = capabilities.operations.includes('conversation.sendMessage') &&
  capabilities.contentTypes.includes('text');
const canCallTools = capabilities.operations.includes('tools.call');

console.log('Can send text messages', canSendText);
console.log('Can call remote tools', canCallTools);
console.log('Supports tool list change notifications', capabilities.toolListChanged);
console.log('Supports resource list change notifications', capabilities.resourceListChanged);
```

Use `.includes()` to look for a value in a list. For notification flags, `true` means the notification is available. Capabilities can change as the connection changes. Use the `capabilitieschange` event to read the latest values. See [capabilities](#capabilities) for all fields.

On Rokid Glasses (2nd generation), previewing a local page with `aix launch-page` returned these values in both full-screen and card previews:

```json
{
  "connectionState": "unavailable",
  "capabilities": {
    "operations": [],
    "contentTypes": [],
    "toolListChanged": false,
    "resourceListChanged": false
  }
}
```

`unavailable` means the current page has no available Agent session. Both `operations` and `contentTypes` are empty, and both notification flags are `false`. To check what an active session supports, read `agent.capabilities` again when `connectionState` is `ready`.

## Send a User Message

Send text from an App or Page business method. Success acknowledges receipt; it does not mean the model has replied:

```javascript
async function askAboutProduct() {
  const agent = getApp().getAgent();
  try {
    await agent.conversation.sendMessage({
      role: 'user',
      content: [{ type: 'text', text: 'Describe product DEMO.' }],
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(error.name, error.message);
  }
}
```

## Publish and Remove Context Explicitly

Application state and logs do not automatically become model input. Publish relevant background data as a context entry and retain its handle:

```javascript
const agent = getApp().getAgent();
const selection = await agent.provideContext({
  key: 'selection',
  description: 'The product selected by the user',
  value: { selectedSku: 'DEMO' },
});

// Replace this entry when the user changes their selection:
await selection.update({ selectedSku: 'SKU-002' });

// Remove it when the workflow ends:
selection.dispose();
```

Publishing and updating context neither sends a user message nor starts inference. Success acknowledges receipt without guaranteeing that a model has read the data. Entries are published together and updates are ordered. An entry is read-only model background, not shared two-way state.

## Send a Card

Use `sendCard()` to show a card in the conversation. Send only when the session is ready and supports `conversation.sendCard`.

```javascript
async function showProductCard() {
  try {
    const agent = getApp().getAgent();
    if (agent.connectionState !== 'ready' ||
        !agent.capabilities.operations.includes('conversation.sendCard')) {
      return;
    }

    await agent.conversation.sendCard({
      title: 'Product DEMO',
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Failed to send card', error);
  }
}

showProductCard();
```

- `title` is the card title. `href` is the link that opens when the user taps the card. Some runtimes return `DataError` if you pass `href`. Card descriptions and `data` are not displayed yet.
- Each send creates a new card. There is currently no delete API.
- If the model also needs the information on the card, pass it to `provideContext()`.

## Use Remote Tools and Resources

Remote tool names and arguments follow the current service contract. This example assumes the service provides `check_stock`:

```javascript
const agent = getApp().getAgent();
const result = await agent.callTool('check_stock', { sku: 'DEMO' });
if (result.isError) {
  console.error(result.content);
} else {
  console.log(result.structuredContent ?? result.content);
}

const page = await agent.listResources();
const resource = page.resources[0];
if (resource) console.log(await agent.readResource(resource.uri));
```

`isError` reports a business failure while the Promise still resolves. Connection, authorization, and protocol failures reject. When `page.nextCursor` exists, continue with `listResources({ cursor: page.nextCursor })`. Resource content can be text or base64 binary and should not be executed as script.

## Connection and Lifecycle

- Available in App/Page scripts only. Standalone Agent Workers do not provide `getAgent()`.
- Obtain the current session at the start of each workflow. Rebinding the connection invalidates the old session, context entries, and card handles. Old data is not republished to the new connection automatically.
- Requests wait for connection readiness. The default 30-second timeout includes queueing and connection time. Cancellation and timeout cannot undo writes already processed; do not automatically retry operations that modify data.
- Dispose of context when the page no longer needs it, or bind it to a `lifetime`. Navigation does not delete sent cards. Cards may remain in the conversation after the App exits, but old handles become unusable.
- Sessions cannot read the entire conversation and do not modify the private history of `LanguageModelSession`. JSON payloads are limited to 1 MiB, with at most 128 pending requests.

## API Reference

### App

#### `getAgent()`

Returns the current `AgentSession`. Getting a handle neither starts inference nor creates a new conversation.

#### `environment`

Independent, read-only public environment object; see `Environment` below. Its content is not automatically published to the model.

### `AgentSession`

#### `connectionState`

Read-only state: `unavailable` (no service), `connecting`, `ready`, or `closed` (an old session has closed).

#### `capabilities`

A read-only snapshot of the current session capabilities. The lists can be empty. If a notification is unavailable, its field is `false`.

| Field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `operations` | `readonly string[]` | Operation names supported by the current session. See the table below. |
| `contentTypes` | `readonly 'text'[]` | Currently, `text` is the only possible value. If the list is empty, the session does not support sending text. |
| `toolListChanged` | `boolean` | `true` means `toolschange` notifications are available. |
| `resourceListChanged` | `boolean` | `true` means `resourceschange` notifications are available. |

This page covers the following operations.

| Operation | Use |
| --- | --- |
| `conversation.sendMessage` | Send a user message |
| `conversation.sendCard` | Send a card |
| `conversation.updateContext` | Publish, update, or remove context |
| `tools.call` | Call a remote tool |
| `resources.list` | List remote resources |
| `resources.read` | Read a remote resource |

#### `invocation`

Read-only latest invocation information or `null`. Contains `invocationId`, `revision`, and a `type` identifying input, partial input, result, or cancellation. Partial input is not complete or validated business input.

#### `conversation`

Read-only message and card operation object providing the send methods below.

#### `provideContext(source, options?)`

Returns `Promise<ContextEntry>`. A session supports up to 128 entries. Duplicate keys reject with `InvalidStateError`. Requires `conversation.updateContext`.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `source.key` | `string` | Yes | 1–128 letters, digits, underscores, dots, or hyphens; unique in the session. |
| `source.description` | `string` | Yes | Description containing non-whitespace text. |
| `source.value` | JSON value | Yes | Background data explicitly supplied to the model. |
| `options.lifetime` | `AbortSignal` | No | Automatically removes the entry when aborted; separate from the request `signal`. |

`options` also accepts the common request options below.

#### `callTool(name, input, options?)`

Returns `Promise<ToolResult>` and requires `tools.call`. `name` is the remote tool name; `input` is a JSON object. Results contain `content` (text entries) and optional `structuredContent`, `isError`, and `uiMetadata`; `uiMetadata` is for presentation only. In addition to common request options, `options.onProgress(progress)` receives `value` and optional `total` and `message`.

#### `listResources(options?)`

Returns `Promise<{ resources, nextCursor? }>` and requires `resources.list`. Options accept `cursor: string` alongside common request options. Resource descriptors contain `uri`, `name`, and optional `description` and `mimeType`.

#### `readResource(uri, options?)`

Returns `Promise<ResourceContent[]>` and requires `resources.read`. Each item contains `uri`, optional `mimeType`, and either `text` or a base64 `blob`.

#### `connectionstatechange`

Fires when connection state changes. The new state is in read-only `event.detail`.

#### `capabilitieschange`

Fires when the capability snapshot changes, with the new snapshot in `event.detail`.

#### `toolinput`

Fires for complete invocation input. `event.detail` contains invocation information and `input`.

#### `toolinputpartial`

Fires for partial input. Do not execute `event.detail` as completed business arguments.

#### `toolresult`

Fires for an invocation result, available in `event.detail.result`.

#### `toolcancelled`

Fires for invocation cancellation. `event.detail` may include `reason`.

#### `toolschange`

Remote tool list change notification. Availability is indicated by `capabilities.toolListChanged`.

#### `resourceschange`

Remote resource list change notification. Availability is indicated by `capabilities.resourceListChanged`.

### `Conversation`

#### `sendMessage(message, options?)`

Returns `Promise<void>`. Requires `conversation.sendMessage` and text content support. Currently only `{ role: 'user', content: [{ type: 'text', text: string }] }` is supported. Completion acknowledges processing, not completed inference.

#### `sendCard(definition, options?)`

Returns `Promise<CardHandle>` and requires `conversation.sendCard`. The card definition accepts the fields below. Cards accept common request options but no `lifetime`.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `string` | Yes | Card title; must contain non-whitespace text. |
| `href` | `string` | No | Address opened when the card is tapped; some runtime versions do not yet support it and return a `DataError` when it is provided. |
| `description` | `string` | No | Card description; display support is planned. |
| `data` | JSON object | No | Optional card data; display support is planned. |

### `ContextEntry`

#### `update(value, options?)`

Returns `Promise<void>` and replaces this entry's entire JSON value without changing other entries. Accepts common request options.

#### `dispose()`

Returns `undefined`. Removes the local entry immediately and schedules publication of remaining entries, without an awaitable acknowledgment. Removing the last entry clears the published context.

### `CardHandle`

#### `id`

Read-only, runtime-generated identifier scoped to the connection and App.

### Common Request Options and Errors

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `signal` | `AbortSignal` | None | Cancels one request without removing sent cards or established context. |
| `timeoutMs` | `number` | `30000` | 1–120000 milliseconds, including connection and queue time. |

Unsupported operations reject with `NotSupportedError`; closed sessions reject with `InvalidStateError`. Other errors include `NotAllowedError`, `AbortError`, `TimeoutError`, `NetworkError`, `DataError`, and `QuotaExceededError`.

### `Environment`

#### `theme`

Optional, read-only environment theme name. Reading it does not change rendering configuration.

#### `locale`

Optional, read-only environment locale. Does not change `navigator.language`.

#### `displayMode`

Optional, read-only name of the current display mode.

#### `availableDisplayModes`

Optional, read-only array of available display mode names. Do not modify it directly.

#### `safeAreaInsets`

Optional, read-only `{ top, right, bottom, left }` snapshot of safe-area insets.

#### `change`

Fires when the environment updates, with the new snapshot in `event.detail`. Listen through `getApp().environment.addEventListener('change', listener)`.

title: Agent 会话
content:
# Agent 会话

通过 `getApp().getAgent()` 向当前 Agent 会话发布背景数据、发送用户消息、发送卡片，以及调用远端工具和读取资源。它不会创建模型或新对话。

## 查看会话支持哪些功能

在 App 或 Page 中，先用 `getApp().getAgent()` 获取当前会话，再读取 `agent.capabilities`。下面的示例会打印实际返回的值，并检查能否发文本消息、调用远端工具，以及接收列表变化通知。

```javascript
const agent = getApp().getAgent();
const capabilities = agent.capabilities;
console.log(JSON.stringify({ connectionState: agent.connectionState, capabilities }));

const canSendText = capabilities.operations.includes('conversation.sendMessage') &&
  capabilities.contentTypes.includes('text');
const canCallTools = capabilities.operations.includes('tools.call');

console.log('可以发送文本消息', canSendText);
console.log('可以调用远端工具', canCallTools);
console.log('支持工具列表变化通知', capabilities.toolListChanged);
console.log('支持资源列表变化通知', capabilities.resourceListChanged);
```

用 `.includes()` 检查列表里有没有指定的值。对于通知字段，`true` 表示支持。能力可能随连接变化，可以在 `capabilitieschange` 事件中读取最新值。完整字段见 [capabilities](#capabilities)。

在 Rokid Glasses 2 代上，通过 `aix launch-page` 预览本地页面时，全屏和卡片预览都返回了下面的结果：

```json
{
  "connectionState": "unavailable",
  "capabilities": {
    "operations": [],
    "contentTypes": [],
    "toolListChanged": false,
    "resourceListChanged": false
  }
}
```

`unavailable` 表示当前页面没有可用的 Agent 会话。这时 `operations` 和 `contentTypes` 都为空，两个通知字段都是 `false`。要判断活跃会话支持哪些操作，请在 `connectionState` 为 `ready` 时重新读取 `agent.capabilities`。

## 发送用户消息

在 App 或 Page 的业务方法中发送文本消息。操作成功表示会话确认接收，不代表模型已经回复：

```javascript
async function askAboutProduct() {
  const agent = getApp().getAgent();
  try {
    await agent.conversation.sendMessage({
      role: 'user',
      content: [{ type: 'text', text: '请介绍商品 DEMO。' }],
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(error.name, error.message);
  }
}
```

## 显式发布和移除上下文

应用状态和日志不会自动成为模型输入。把需要的背景数据发布为上下文条目，并保留返回的句柄：

```javascript
const agent = getApp().getAgent();
const selection = await agent.provideContext({
  key: 'selection',
  description: 'The product selected by the user',
  value: { selectedSku: 'DEMO' },
});

// 用户改选商品时替换这一条的值：
await selection.update({ selectedSku: 'SKU-002' });

// 业务结束时移除：
selection.dispose();
```

发布和更新不会发送用户消息或自动开始推理；成功只表示确认接收，不保证模型已经读取。多个条目汇总发布，更新按顺序发送。条目是模型只读背景，不是双向共享状态。

## 发送卡片

用 `sendCard()` 在会话里显示一张卡片。会话就绪且支持 `conversation.sendCard` 时才发送。

```javascript
async function showProductCard() {
  try {
    const agent = getApp().getAgent();
    if (agent.connectionState !== 'ready' ||
        !agent.capabilities.operations.includes('conversation.sendCard')) {
      return;
    }

    await agent.conversation.sendCard({
      title: '商品 DEMO',
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('发送卡片失败', error);
  }
}

showProductCard();
```

- `title` 是卡片标题，`href` 是点击后打开的链接。部分运行时传入 `href` 会报 `DataError`。卡片描述和 `data` 暂不展示。
- 每次发送都会创建新卡片，目前没有删除接口。
- 如果模型也需要卡片里的信息，请用 `provideContext()` 提供。

## 使用远端工具和资源

远端工具名称和参数以当前服务提供的契约为准。下面假定服务已提供 `check_stock`：

```javascript
const agent = getApp().getAgent();
const result = await agent.callTool('check_stock', { sku: 'DEMO' });
if (result.isError) {
  console.error(result.content);
} else {
  console.log(result.structuredContent ?? result.content);
}

const page = await agent.listResources();
const resource = page.resources[0];
if (resource) console.log(await agent.readResource(resource.uri));
```

`isError` 是工具返回的业务失败，Promise 仍会完成；连接、授权和协议失败会拒绝。`page.nextCursor` 存在时，用 `listResources({ cursor: page.nextCursor })` 继续读取。资源内容可能是文本或 base64 二进制，不应当作脚本执行。

## 连接与生命周期

- 只在 App/Page 中使用。独立 Agent Worker 不提供 `getAgent()`。
- 每次业务流程开始时获取当前会话。连接重建后，旧会话、上下文条目和卡片句柄失效；不会自动把旧数据发布到新连接。
- 请求会等待连接就绪。默认超时 30 秒，包含排队和等待连接的时间；取消和超时无法撤回已经处理的写入。会修改数据的操作不要自动重试。
- 页面不再需要上下文时主动 `dispose()`，或用 `lifetime` 绑定生命周期。导航不会自动删除已发送卡片；卡片可能在 App 退出后继续保留在会话中，但旧句柄不再可用。
- 会话不能读取整个对话，也不会修改 `LanguageModelSession` 的私有历史。JSON payload 上限 1 MiB，最多 128 个待完成请求。

## API Reference

### App

#### `getAgent()`

返回当前 `AgentSession`。获取句柄不开始推理，也不创建新对话。

#### `environment`

只读、独立的公开环境对象，详见下方 `Environment`；内容不会自动发布给模型。

### `AgentSession`

#### `connectionState`

只读状态：`unavailable`（无服务）、`connecting`（连接中）、`ready`（可用）、`closed`（旧会话关闭）。

#### `capabilities`

当前会话能力的只读快照。列表可以为空，通知不可用时对应字段为 `false`。

| 字段 | 类型 | 值的含义 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `operations` | `readonly string[]` | 当前会话支持的操作名，见下表。 |
| `contentTypes` | `readonly 'text'[]` | 目前唯一的可选值是 `text`。空列表表示当前会话不支持发送文本。 |
| `toolListChanged` | `boolean` | `true` 表示支持 `toolschange` 通知。 |
| `resourceListChanged` | `boolean` | `true` 表示支持 `resourceschange` 通知。 |

以下是本页介绍的操作：

| 操作名 | 用途 |
| --- | --- |
| `conversation.sendMessage` | 发送用户消息 |
| `conversation.sendCard` | 发送卡片 |
| `conversation.updateContext` | 发布、更新或移除上下文 |
| `tools.call` | 调用远端工具 |
| `resources.list` | 列出远端资源 |
| `resources.read` | 读取远端资源 |

#### `invocation`

只读的最新调用信息或 `null`。包含 `invocationId`、`revision` 和区分输入、部分输入、结果或取消的 `type`。部分输入不是完整或已校验的参数。

#### `conversation`

只读的消息与卡片操作对象，提供下述发送方法。

#### `provideContext(source, options?)`

返回 `Promise<ContextEntry>`。同会话最多 128 条上下文；重复 key 以 `InvalidStateError` 拒绝。需要 `conversation.updateContext` 能力。

| 字段 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `source.key` | `string` | 是 | 1–128 个字母、数字、下划线、点或连字符；会话内唯一。 |
| `source.description` | `string` | 是 | 不得全为空白的说明。 |
| `source.value` | JSON 值 | 是 | 显式提供给模型的背景数据。 |
| `options.lifetime` | `AbortSignal` | 否 | 中止时自动移除条目；与请求 `signal` 分开。 |

`options` 还接受下方通用请求选项。

#### `callTool(name, input, options?)`

返回 `Promise<ToolResult>`；需要 `tools.call` 能力。`name` 是远端工具名，`input` 是 JSON 对象。结果含 `content`（文本条目数组），以及可选 `structuredContent`、`isError`、`uiMetadata`；`uiMetadata` 仅供界面使用。除通用请求选项外，可用 `options.onProgress(progress)` 接收 `value`、可选 `total` 和 `message`。

#### `listResources(options?)`

返回 `Promise<{ resources, nextCursor? }>`；需要 `resources.list` 能力。选项除通用字段外还接受 `cursor: string`。资源项含 `uri`、`name` 及可选 `description`、`mimeType`。

#### `readResource(uri, options?)`

返回 `Promise<ResourceContent[]>`；需要 `resources.read` 能力。每项含 `uri`、可选 `mimeType`，以及二选一的 `text` 或 base64 `blob`。

#### `connectionstatechange`

连接状态改变时触发，新的状态在只读 `event.detail` 中。

#### `capabilitieschange`

能力快照改变时触发，新的能力在 `event.detail` 中。

#### `toolinput`

收到完整调用输入时触发，`event.detail` 包含调用信息和 `input`。

#### `toolinputpartial`

收到部分输入时触发，`event.detail` 不应作为已完成的业务参数执行。

#### `toolresult`

收到调用结果时触发，结果在 `event.detail.result` 中。

#### `toolcancelled`

收到调用取消信息时触发，`event.detail` 可含 `reason`。

#### `toolschange`

远端工具列表变化通知；是否提供此通知见 `capabilities.toolListChanged`。

#### `resourceschange`

远端资源列表变化通知；是否提供此通知见 `capabilities.resourceListChanged`。

### `Conversation`

#### `sendMessage(message, options?)`

返回 `Promise<void>`，需要 `conversation.sendMessage` 和文本内容能力。目前 `message` 仅支持 `{ role: 'user', content: [{ type: 'text', text: string }] }`；完成表示确认处理，不表示推理已完成。

#### `sendCard(definition, options?)`

返回 `Promise<CardHandle>`，需要 `conversation.sendCard`。卡片定义包含以下字段；通用请求选项不支持卡片 `lifetime`。

| 字段 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `string` | 是 | 卡片标题，必须包含非空白文本。 |
| `href` | `string` | 否 | 点击卡片后打开的地址；部分运行时版本尚不支持，传入会返回 `DataError`。 |
| `description` | `string` | 否 | 卡片描述；展示将在后续支持。 |
| `data` | JSON 对象 | 否 | 可选的卡片数据；展示将在后续支持。 |

### `ContextEntry`

#### `update(value, options?)`

返回 `Promise<void>`，完整替换该条目的 JSON 值，其他条目不变。支持通用请求选项。

#### `dispose()`

返回 `undefined`，立即移除本地条目并安排发布剩余条目；没有可等待的确认结果。移除最后一条会清空发布内容。

### `CardHandle`

#### `id`

只读、由运行时生成的卡片标识，限定在所属连接和 App 内。

### 通用请求选项与错误

| 字段 | 类型 | 默认值 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `signal` | `AbortSignal` | 无 | 取消单次请求，不移除已发送卡片或已建立的上下文。 |
| `timeoutMs` | `number` | `30000` | 1–120000 毫秒，包含等待连接和排队时间。 |

不支持的操作以 `NotSupportedError` 拒绝，关闭的会话以 `InvalidStateError` 拒绝。其他错误包括 `NotAllowedError`、`AbortError`、`TimeoutError`、`NetworkError`、`DataError`、`QuotaExceededError`。

### `Environment`

#### `theme`

可选、只读的环境主题名称；读取不会修改渲染主题。

#### `locale`

可选、只读的环境语言；不修改 `navigator.language`。

#### `displayMode`

可选、只读的当前显示模式名称。

#### `availableDisplayModes`

可选、只读的可用显示模式名称数组；不要直接修改。

#### `safeAreaInsets`

可选、只读的 `{ top, right, bottom, left }` 安全区域边距快照。

#### `change`

环境更新时触发，`event.detail` 是新快照。通过 `getApp().environment.addEventListener('change', listener)` 监听。

content:
# Speech Synthesis

Speech synthesis converts text into spoken output. It is well suited for welcome messages, spoken replies, navigation prompts, status reminders, and similar scenarios. AIUI provides two independent methods: `speechSynthesis.speak()` generates and plays speech directly, with all `speak()` requests sharing a runtime-managed speech player; `speechSynthesis.synthesize()` only creates a generation task and does not play it automatically, leaving playback timing and state to a caller-created `SpeechAudioPlayer`.

In AIUI, speech synthesis is typically used at the output stage of a workflow. Use `speak()` when the result only needs to be read aloud. Use `synthesize()` when you need subtitles, audio chunks, or independent playback control. Calling either method does not automatically call the other.

## Speak a Text Response

<!-- aiui-api-style default=web -->

**Web**

```javascript api-style=web
const utterance = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance('欢迎使用 AIUI');
speechSynthesis.speak(utterance, 'enqueue');
```

**wx**

```javascript api-style=wx
wx.speech.playTTS('欢迎使用 AIUI');
```

<!-- /aiui-api-style -->

`speak()` immediately enters the direct-playback flow and does not return a generation task or an independent player. Multiple calls share one speech player, and `mode` determines whether a request joins the shared queue or plays immediately.

## Select a Voice

Both `speechSynthesis.speak()` and `speechSynthesis.synthesize()` use `SpeechSynthesisUtterance` as the speech-synthesis request. See the API Reference below for the support status of each property. Set a voice ID through `voice`, then choose one method based on whether you need independent playback control. The following blocks show alternative workflows, not steps that must run in sequence:

```javascript
// Path 1: play directly through the shared speak() player
const spokenUtterance = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance('Welcome to AIUI');
spokenUtterance.voice = 'English_radiant_girl';
speechSynthesis.speak(spokenUtterance, 'enqueue');
```

```javascript
// Path 2: create a task, then control an independent player
const generatedUtterance = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance('Welcome to AIUI');
generatedUtterance.voice = 'English_radiant_girl';

const task = await speechSynthesis.synthesize(generatedUtterance, {
  subtitles: 'word',
});
const player = new SpeechAudioPlayer(task);
player.play();
```

## Generate Audio and Synchronized Subtitles

To separate generation from playback, create a task with `synthesize()` and play it through `SpeechAudioPlayer`. `synthesize()` itself only starts generation; it does not enter the shared player or playback queue used by `speak()`:

```javascript
const utterance = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance('Welcome to AIUI');
const task = await speechSynthesis.synthesize(utterance, {
  subtitles: 'word',
  audio: { preferredFormat: 'mp3' },
});

console.log('actual format:', task.audioConfig.format);

const player = new SpeechAudioPlayer(task);
player.textTrack.addEventListener('cuechange', () => {
  const cue = player.textTrack.activeCues.item(0);
  console.log(cue?.text ?? '');
});
player.play();
```

`preferredFormat` is only a preference hint. Always use `task.audioConfig.format` as the actual format.

## Choose Between `speak()` and `synthesize()`

Both methods accept a `SpeechSynthesisUtterance`, but they differ in who owns the generated result and how playback is controlled:

| Comparison | `speak()` | `synthesize()` |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Primary responsibility | Generate speech and play it directly | Create a generation task without playing it automatically |
| Return value | `void`; no task or player is exposed | `Promise<SpeechSynthesisTask>` |
| Player | All calls share the runtime-managed speech player | The caller can create an independent `SpeechAudioPlayer` for the task |
| Playback control | Use `mode` to enqueue or play immediately | Use the player to play, pause, stop, and seek |
| Subtitles and chunks | Not exposed to the caller | Exposes audio chunks, subtitle cues, and task events |
| Best for | Welcome messages, prompts, and ordinary replies that only need direct playback | Synchronized subtitles, custom playback UI, streaming processing, task cancellation, or independent playback control |

The methods do not share task state: a task created by `synthesize()` does not join the shared `speak()` playback queue, and `speak()` does not return a task that can be passed to `SpeechAudioPlayer`. Calling both methods for the same text starts two independent speech-generation requests.

## Recommendations

- Keep spoken text short enough to be understood in a single listen, rather than reading long paragraphs directly.
- Prefer `speak()` for direct playback. Use `synthesize()` only when you need subtitles, chunks, or independent playback control.
- For multiple consecutive replies, control the playback rhythm at the business layer to avoid overwhelming users with too much simultaneous voice output.
- Use different wording lengths and tones for important prompts versus ordinary prompts.

## Current Capability Scope

- [x] Play directly through the shared `speechSynthesis.speak()` player and use `mode` to enqueue or play immediately.
- [x] Independently generate tasks, audio chunks, and subtitle cues through `speechSynthesis.synthesize()`, then optionally play them through `SpeechAudioPlayer`.
- [x] Properties on `SpeechSynthesisUtterance` are used by both `speak()` and `synthesize()`.
- [x] `volume` accepts integers from `0` to `10` and defaults to `1`.
- [ ] `lang` is not currently supported. Setting it does not change the language used for speech generation.
- [ ] `cancel()`, `pause()`, `resume()`, `getVoices()`, and the full utterance lifecycle events are not exposed yet.

## Read Next

- **[Speech Recognition](/AIUI/api/ai-speech-recognition)**: Learn how to convert user speech into text.
- **[Large Language Model](/AIUI/api/ai-language-model)**: Learn how to generate reply content that can be spoken aloud.

`SpeechAudioPlayer.textTrack` cues retain identity across lists and ID lookup. Keep a cue object to edit it or remove it by identity. See [AudioPlayer](/AIUI/api/media-audio-player) for the full text-track API.

## API Reference

### Entry Point

Speech synthesis is based on the global `speechSynthesis` object and `SpeechSynthesisUtterance`. `speak()` is the direct-playback entry point:

```javascript
const spokenUtterance = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance('Welcome to AIUI');
speechSynthesis.speak(spokenUtterance, 'enqueue');
```

`synthesize()` is the independent task-generation entry point:

```javascript
const generatedUtterance = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance('Welcome to AIUI');
const task = await speechSynthesis.synthesize(generatedUtterance);
const player = new SpeechAudioPlayer(task);
player.play();
```

These entry points represent different workflows. Choose one based on whether you need an independent task and playback controls instead of calling both in sequence for one playback operation.

`SpeechSynthesisUtterance` can also be used through the built-in `speech` module.

### `SpeechSynthesisUtterance`

`SpeechSynthesisUtterance` is a mutable speech-synthesis request object. Both `speechSynthesis.speak()` and `speechSynthesis.synthesize()` accept this object and handle its currently supported properties consistently.

#### `new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(text?)`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | `string` | No | Initial text to speak; defaults to `''`. |

#### `utterance.text`

Writable `string`, defaulting to an empty string. Create an empty request and set text later.

#### `utterance.lang`

Writable `string`, defaulting to `'en-US'`; the current speech service does not use it to switch languages.

#### `utterance.pitch`

Writable `number`, defaulting to `1`; adjustment support depends on the speech service.

#### `utterance.rate`

Writable `number`, defaulting to `1`; adjustment support depends on the speech service.

#### `utterance.volume`

Writable `number`, defaulting to `1`. Fractional values are retained rather than converted to integers on assignment. Audible volume depends on the speech service.

#### `utterance.voice`

Writable `string | null`, defaulting to `null` to select the default voice.

**Available voices**

| Voice ID | Voice type | Recommended use |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `female-tianmei` | Sweet Mandarin female voice | Short Mandarin text with `tts_streaming` |
| `English_radiant_girl` | Energetic English female voice | Short English text with `tts_streaming` |
| `English_expressive_narrator` | Expressive English narrator | Long English text with `tts_streaming` |
| `male-qn-qingse` | Young Mandarin male voice | The runtime's current default voice and general conversation |
| `male-qn-jingying` | Mature Mandarin male voice | Business content and assistant announcements |
| `female-yujie` | Mature Mandarin female voice | Brand introductions and content narration |
| `Chinese (Mandarin)_News_Anchor` | Mandarin female news voice | News and informational announcements |
| `Chinese (Mandarin)_Radio_Host` | Mandarin male radio voice | Long-form text and stories |
| `clever_boy` | Mandarin boy voice | Children's content |
| `lovely_girl` | Mandarin girl voice | Children's content |
| `English_Trustworthy_Man` | Trustworthy English male voice | English assistants and business content |

### Methods

#### `speechSynthesis.speak(utterance, mode?)`

`speak()` generates and directly plays speech using the current properties of `utterance`. It returns `void`. All `speak()` calls share one runtime-managed speech player and playback queue; that player is not exposed as an object to the caller.

- `utterance`: A `SpeechSynthesisUtterance` instance. At present, playback is mainly initiated using its text content.
- `mode`: Optional playback mode. Supported values are:
  - `'enqueue'`: Append the current playback request to the queue.
  - `'immediate'`: Play the current utterance immediately.

If `mode` is omitted, it defaults to `'enqueue'`, which appends the current playback request to the queue.

`speak()` does not create a `SpeechSynthesisTask` and does not use the independently controlled playback flow provided by a caller-created `SpeechAudioPlayer`.

#### `speechSynthesis.synthesize(utterance, options?)`

Creates an independent streaming speech-generation task without starting playback automatically. Returns `Promise<SpeechSynthesisTask>`. The task does not enter the shared player or playback queue used by `speak()`. To play it, create a `SpeechAudioPlayer` for the task and control playback explicitly.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `utterance` | `SpeechSynthesisUtterance` | Yes | Speech request to synthesize. |
| `options.subtitles` | `'none' \| 'sentence' \| 'word'` | No | Subtitle-cue granularity. |
| `options.audio.preferredFormat` | `'pcm' \| 'mp3' \| 'ogg_opus'` | No | Preferred output audio format. |
| `options.audio.sampleRate` | `number` | No | Preferred sample rate. |
| `options.audio.channels` | `1 \| 2` | No | Preferred channel count. |
| `options.audio.bitrate` | `number` | No | Preferred bitrate. |
| `options.signal` | `AbortSignal` | No | Signal used to cancel generation. |

### `SpeechSynthesisTask`

| Member | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | Task identifier. |
| `state` | `'running' \| 'completed' \| 'aborted' \| 'errored'` | Current task state. |
| `audioConfig` | `SpeechSynthesisAudioConfig` | Actual generated format, sample rate, channels, sample format, and MIME type. |
| `language` | `string` | Actual language. |
| `granularity` | `'none' \| 'sentence' \| 'word'` | Actual subtitle granularity. |
| `finished` | `Promise<{ duration: number }>` | Resolves when the task finishes. |
| `abort()` | `void` | Aborts generation. |

The task dispatches `chunk`, `end`, `error`, and `abort` events and exposes the matching `onchunk`, `onend`, `onerror`, and `onabort` properties. A `chunk` event contains `audio: Uint8Array` and `cues: readonly SpeechSynthesisCue[]`.

### `new SpeechAudioPlayer(task, options?)`

Creates an independent player that consumes the specified `SpeechSynthesisTask`. It is only used with tasks from `synthesize()` and neither represents nor controls the shared speech player inside `speak()`. `options.trackMode` can be `'hidden'` or `'showing'`.

| Member | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `audioPlayer` | `AudioPlayer` | Underlying audio player. |
| `textTrack` | `TextTrack` | Subtitle track updated from generated cues. |
| `activeCue` | `VTTCue \| null` | Currently active subtitle cue. |
| `currentTime` / `duration` | `number` | Current playback time and duration. |
| `paused` | `boolean` | Whether playback is paused. |
| `play()` / `pause()` / `stop()` | `void` | Controls playback state. |
| `seek(position)` | `void` | Seeks to a time in seconds. |
| `destroy()` | `void` | Releases player resources. |

title: 语音播报
content:
# 语音播报

语音播报用于把文本内容转换成语音输出，适合欢迎语、回复播报、导航提示、状态提醒等场景。AIUI 提供两种彼此独立的方法：`speechSynthesis.speak()` 生成语音后直接播放，所有 `speak()` 请求共享一个由运行时管理的语音播放器；`speechSynthesis.synthesize()` 只创建语音生成任务，不会自动播放，播放时机和状态由调用方创建的 `SpeechAudioPlayer` 控制。

在 AIUI 中，语音播报通常用在结果输出阶段：只需要把结果读给用户时使用 `speak()`；需要字幕、音频分片或独立播放控制时使用 `synthesize()`。调用其中一种方法不会自动调用另一种方法。

## 播报一段文本

<!-- aiui-api-style default=web -->

**Web**

```javascript api-style=web
const utterance = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance('欢迎使用 AIUI');
speechSynthesis.speak(utterance, 'enqueue');
```

**wx**

```javascript api-style=wx
wx.speech.playTTS('欢迎使用 AIUI');
```

<!-- /aiui-api-style -->

`speak()` 会立即进入直接播报流程，不会返回生成任务或独立播放器。多次调用共享同一个语音播放器，并通过 `mode` 决定加入共享队列还是立即播放。

## 选择音色播报

`speechSynthesis.speak()` 和 `speechSynthesis.synthesize()` 都使用 `SpeechSynthesisUtterance` 作为语音合成请求，各属性的支持情况见下方 API Reference。通过 `voice` 设置音色 ID，再根据是否需要独立控制播放选择其中一种方法。以下两段代码是互斥的使用路径，并不是必须连续执行的步骤：

```javascript
// 路径一：直接播放，并使用 speak() 的共享播放器
const spokenUtterance = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance('欢迎使用 AIUI');
spokenUtterance.voice = 'female-tianmei';
speechSynthesis.speak(spokenUtterance, 'enqueue');
```

```javascript
// 路径二：只生成任务，再使用独立播放器控制播放
const generatedUtterance = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance('欢迎使用 AIUI');
generatedUtterance.voice = 'female-tianmei';

const task = await speechSynthesis.synthesize(generatedUtterance, {
  subtitles: 'word',
});
const player = new SpeechAudioPlayer(task);
player.play();
```

## 生成音频与同步字幕

如果需要把生成与播放分开，使用 `synthesize()` 创建任务，再交给 `SpeechAudioPlayer` 播放。`synthesize()` 本身只开始生成，不会进入 `speak()` 的共享播放器或共享播放队列：

```javascript
const utterance = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance('欢迎使用 AIUI');
const task = await speechSynthesis.synthesize(utterance, {
  subtitles: 'word',
  audio: { preferredFormat: 'mp3' },
});

console.log('actual format:', task.audioConfig.format);

const player = new SpeechAudioPlayer(task);
player.textTrack.addEventListener('cuechange', () => {
  const cue = player.textTrack.activeCues.item(0);
  console.log(cue?.text ?? '');
});
player.play();
```

`preferredFormat` 只是偏好提示，实际格式始终以 `task.audioConfig.format` 为准。

## 选择 `speak()` 还是 `synthesize()`

两种方法都接收 `SpeechSynthesisUtterance`，但生成结果的所有权和播放方式不同：

| 对比项 | `speak()` | `synthesize()` |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 主要职责 | 生成语音并直接播放 | 创建语音生成任务，不自动播放 |
| 返回结果 | `void`，不暴露任务或播放器 | `Promise<SpeechSynthesisTask>` |
| 播放器 | 所有调用共享运行时管理的语音播放器 | 调用方可为任务创建独立的 `SpeechAudioPlayer` |
| 播放控制 | 通过 `mode` 选择排队或立即播放 | 通过播放器控制播放、暂停、停止和跳转 |
| 字幕与分片 | 不向调用方暴露 | 可监听音频分片、字幕 cue 和任务事件 |
| 适用场景 | 欢迎语、提示音、普通回复等只需直接播报的内容 | 同步字幕、自定义播放界面、流式处理、任务取消或独立播放控制 |

两种方法不会共享任务状态：`synthesize()` 创建的任务不会加入 `speak()` 的共享播放队列，`speak()` 也不会返回可交给 `SpeechAudioPlayer` 的任务。如果对同一段文本同时调用两种方法，会发起两次独立的语音生成请求。

## 使用建议

- 把要播报的文本控制在适合一次听清的长度内，避免整段长文本直接朗读。
- 只需要直接播报时优先使用 `speak()`；只有需要字幕、分片或独立播放控制时才使用 `synthesize()`。
- 对于连续多条回复，建议在业务层控制播报节奏，避免用户同时收到过多语音输出。
- 对重要提示和普通提示使用不同的文案长度与语气。

## 当前能力范围

- [x] 通过 `speechSynthesis.speak()` 使用共享语音播放器直接播报，并通过 `mode` 控制排队或立即播放。
- [x] 通过独立的 `speechSynthesis.synthesize()` 生成任务、音频分片与字幕 cue，并按需使用 `SpeechAudioPlayer` 播放。
- [x] `SpeechSynthesisUtterance` 上的属性同时用于 `speak()` 和 `synthesize()`。
- [x] `volume` 支持 `0` 到 `10` 的整数，默认值为 `1`。
- [ ] `lang` 当前不支持，设置后不会改变语音生成的语言。
- [ ] `cancel()`、`pause()`、`resume()`、`getVoices()` 以及完整的 utterance 生命周期事件（当前未暴露）。

## 继续阅读

- **[语音识别](/AIUI/api/ai-speech-recognition)**：查看如何把用户语音转换成文本。
- **[大语言模型](/AIUI/api/ai-language-model)**：查看如何生成可播报的回复内容。

`SpeechAudioPlayer.textTrack` 的 cue 在列表与 ID 查询之间保持对象身份，可以保留对象、修改属性并按同一对象删除。完整字幕接口见 [AudioPlayer](/AIUI/api/media-audio-player)。

## API Reference

### 入口

语音播报基于全局 `speechSynthesis` 对象和 `SpeechSynthesisUtterance`。`speak()` 是直接播放入口：

```javascript
const spokenUtterance = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance('欢迎使用 AIUI');
speechSynthesis.speak(spokenUtterance, 'enqueue');
```

`synthesize()` 是独立的任务生成入口：

```javascript
const generatedUtterance = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance('欢迎使用 AIUI');
const task = await speechSynthesis.synthesize(generatedUtterance);
const player = new SpeechAudioPlayer(task);
player.play();
```

示例中的两条入口用于不同工作流。实际使用时应根据是否需要独立任务和播放控制选择其中一种，而不是为了完成一次播报依次调用两者。

`SpeechSynthesisUtterance` 也可通过内置 `speech` 模块使用。

### `SpeechSynthesisUtterance`

`SpeechSynthesisUtterance` 是一个可修改的语音合成请求对象。`speechSynthesis.speak()` 和 `speechSynthesis.synthesize()` 都接收该对象，并对当前支持的属性采用相同的处理方式。

#### `new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(text?)`

| 参数 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | `string` | 否 | 初始播报文本，省略时为 `''`。 |

#### `utterance.text`

可写的 `string`，默认空字符串；可以先创建空请求，再设置文本。

#### `utterance.lang`

可写的 `string`，默认 `'en-US'`；当前语音服务不支持用此属性切换语言。

#### `utterance.pitch`

可写的 `number`，默认 `1`；是否支持调整由语音服务决定。

#### `utterance.rate`

可写的 `number`，默认 `1`；是否支持调整由语音服务决定。

#### `utterance.volume`

可写的 `number`，默认 `1`；可保存小数值，不会在对象赋值时自动转换为整数。实际音量效果取决于语音服务。

#### `utterance.voice`

可写的 `string | null`，默认 `null`，此时使用默认音色。

**可用音色**

| Voice ID | 类型 | 用途 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `female-tianmei` | 中文甜美女声 | `tts_streaming` 中文短文本 |
| `English_radiant_girl` | 英文活力女声 | `tts_streaming` 英文短文本 |
| `English_expressive_narrator` | 英文叙事声 | `tts_streaming` 英文长文本 |
| `male-qn-qingse` | 中文青年男声 | 运行时当前默认音色、通用对话 |
| `male-qn-jingying` | 中文成熟男声 | 商务、助手播报 |
| `female-yujie` | 中文成熟御姐 | 品牌介绍、内容解说 |
| `Chinese (Mandarin)_News_Anchor` | 中文新闻女声 | 新闻和信息播报 |
| `Chinese (Mandarin)_Radio_Host` | 中文电台男声 | 长文本和故事 |
| `clever_boy` | 中文男童 | 儿童内容 |
| `lovely_girl` | 中文女童 | 儿童内容 |
| `English_Trustworthy_Man` | 英文可信男声 | 英文助手、商务内容 |

### 方法

#### `speechSynthesis.speak(utterance, mode?)`

`speak()` 使用当前 `utterance` 的属性生成语音并直接播放，返回 `void`。所有 `speak()` 调用共享一个由运行时管理的语音播放器和播放队列；该播放器不会作为对象暴露给调用方。

- `utterance`：`SpeechSynthesisUtterance` 实例，当前主要使用其中的文本内容发起播报。
- `mode`：可选的播报模式，支持以下取值：
  - `'enqueue'`：把当前播报请求追加到播放队列中。
  - `'immediate'`：立即播放当前播报。

如果省略 `mode`，默认按 `'enqueue'` 处理，也就是把当前播报请求追加到播放队列中。

`speak()` 不会创建 `SpeechSynthesisTask`，也不会使用调用方通过 `SpeechAudioPlayer` 控制的独立播放流程。

#### `speechSynthesis.synthesize(utterance, options?)`

创建独立的流式语音生成任务，但不会自动开始播放。返回 `Promise<SpeechSynthesisTask>`。该任务不进入 `speak()` 的共享播放器或播放队列；需要播放时，调用方应为任务创建 `SpeechAudioPlayer` 并自行控制播放状态。

| 参数 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `utterance` | `SpeechSynthesisUtterance` | 是 | 要合成的语音请求。 |
| `options.subtitles` | `'none' \| 'sentence' \| 'word'` | 否 | 字幕 cue 的粒度。 |
| `options.audio.preferredFormat` | `'pcm' \| 'mp3' \| 'ogg_opus'` | 否 | 目标音频格式偏好。 |
| `options.audio.sampleRate` | `number` | 否 | 期望采样率。 |
| `options.audio.channels` | `1 \| 2` | 否 | 期望声道数。 |
| `options.audio.bitrate` | `number` | 否 | 期望比特率。 |
| `options.signal` | `AbortSignal` | 否 | 用于取消生成任务。 |

### `SpeechSynthesisTask`

| 成员 | 类型 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | 任务标识。 |
| `state` | `'running' \| 'completed' \| 'aborted' \| 'errored'` | 当前任务状态。 |
| `audioConfig` | `SpeechSynthesisAudioConfig` | 实际生成的格式、采样率、声道、采样格式与 MIME type。 |
| `language` | `string` | 实际语言。 |
| `granularity` | `'none' \| 'sentence' \| 'word'` | 实际字幕粒度。 |
| `finished` | `Promise<{ duration: number }>` | 任务结束后解析。 |
| `abort()` | `void` | 中止生成任务。 |

任务会分发 `chunk`、`end`、`error` 与 `abort` 事件，也可以使用对应的 `onchunk`、`onend`、`onerror` 与 `onabort` 属性。`chunk` 事件包含 `audio: Uint8Array` 和 `cues: readonly SpeechSynthesisCue[]`。

### `new SpeechAudioPlayer(task, options?)`

创建一个消费指定 `SpeechSynthesisTask` 的独立播放器。它只用于 `synthesize()` 生成的任务，不代表也不控制 `speak()` 内部共享的语音播放器。`options.trackMode` 可设为 `'hidden'` 或 `'showing'`。

| 成员 | 类型 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `audioPlayer` | `AudioPlayer` | 底层音频播放器。 |
| `textTrack` | `TextTrack` | 根据生成 cue 更新的字幕轨道。 |
| `activeCue` | `VTTCue \| null` | 当前激活字幕。 |
| `currentTime` / `duration` | `number` | 当前播放时间与时长。 |
| `paused` | `boolean` | 当前是否暂停。 |
| `play()` / `pause()` / `stop()` | `void` | 控制播放状态。 |
| `seek(position)` | `void` | 跳转到指定秒数。 |
| `destroy()` | `void` | 释放播放器资源。 |
